title: 基础人形数字模型
summary: 完全由参数化几何组成的基础人形模型，用真实米制尺寸表达头部、躯干、四肢、关节、手脚、视线、脚底接触点和左右镜像关系，适合作为 Agent 生成人物、工人、角色姿态或人体尺度参照的母版。

ai.intent: 提供一个不用导入外部模型文件的人形数字建模母版，重点帮助 Agent 复用人体比例、左右镜像、关节链、脚底接触、视线方向和可编辑构件命名，而不是追求真实皮肤、衣料或表情级高拟真渲染。
useWhen: 需要在施工、教学、办公、设备操作或安全演示场景中放置可解释的人物比例参照。
需要从一个标准站姿或 A-pose 开始，继续调整头、躯干、手臂、腿部和脚底锚点。
需要给其他 Agent 一个清晰的人体组件命名和左右镜像组织方式，减少每次重新推导人体比例的重复工作。
avoidWhen: 需要真实人物扫描、面部表情、衣料褶皱、肌肉解剖、皮肤材质或影视级角色资产。
需要复杂骨骼蒙皮、IK 反解、步态动画或多人群体行为仿真；这些应由后续姿态/骨架方法承接。
需要表达特定真实人物身份、品牌服装或精确人体医学测量。
qualityChecks: 整体高度应保持在真实人形尺度附近，脚底接触点应落在鞋底下方而不是身体中心。
左右肢体必须使用稳定的 left/right 命名，并保持镜像位置，便于 Agent 后续批量调整姿态。
关节锚点应覆盖头顶、视线、肩、肘、腕、髋、膝、踝、左右手抓取点和脚底接触点。
模型只表达人形本体，不应混入场景地面、工具、设备或无关背景构件。
commonVariants: 施工人员：将 torso-cloth、leg-cloth 改为高可见度颜色，添加安全帽、安全背心和工具腰带。
坐姿人物：降低 pelvis 和 knee 锚点，将 thigh 与 lower-leg 旋转为座椅姿态，并保留 foot-contact。
简化人偶：隐藏面部、手指和服装细节，仅保留头、躯干、四肢和脚底锚点。
姿态动画母版：以 shoulder/elbow/wrist、hip/knee/ankle 锚点作为后续骨架方法的输入。

sections.role: calf fabric volume without pipe look

upper chest width with flatter front/back

upperArm.visualRule: lofted sleeve surface with non-circular limb profile; visible shoulder ball should be subtle

forearm.visualRule: lofted sleeve surface narrows toward glove cuff and keeps forearm from reading as a plastic pipe

thigh.visualRule: flatter trouser crease and side facet break straight pipe silhouette

lowerLeg.visualRule: flatter shin crease and boot overlap prevent stick-leg look

hand.visualRule: smaller palm, thumb, four close-set fingers, tips, and subtle knuckles avoid claw-like hands

footwear.visualRule: shoe volume is lofted along the foot direction instead of box plus sphere toe

face.visualRule: facial features should be low relief patches on a head surface, not isolated toy primitives

aiHints: Use the section widths to keep the waist narrower than the chest and the limbs narrower than the torso.
Use section.profile points on lofted-surface nodes when a human part needs a flattened back, protruding face, broad shoulder, or non-circular palm/trouser outline.
Use axisX/axisZ on lofted-surface sections for features that grow along another direction, such as a nose bridge or shoe length.
Keep pose pivots separate from visible surface nodes; pose belongs to character.human-pose-rig.
If an existing human is missing semantic surface nodes, request addMissing=true in a refinement proposal.
Prefer clothing sleeves and cuffs over exposed cylindrical arms for worker figures; oversized joint balls make the result look like a toy.

annotations.text: Human section profile controls chest/waist/limb proportions
Palm, thumb, four fingers, and fingertip anchors are semantic editable nodes
